context_requirements: Intact oxidative stress response machinery (NFE2L2/KEAP1) for antioxidant gene induction
Functional apoptotic signaling (BAX/BAK, caspase cascade) for late apoptosis genes
Cellular iron/heme availability for artemisinin activation (less critical for non-artemisinin antimalarials)
Proliferating cells for antiproliferative and cell-cycle arrest signatures
falsifiers: No change in CDKN1A, GADD45A, or oxidative stress genes (HMOX1, SQSTM1) at 6 or 24 h in any line
Strong and uniform upregulation of proliferation genes (e.g., MYC, CCND1, PCNA) across lines
Absence of any transcriptional response (all genes unchanged) in all nine lines
Predominant interferon signature without oxidative stress or cell-cycle changes

evidence.supports: Artesunate causes dose-dependent decreases in cell number and cell cycle transit protein reductions, supporting antiproliferative and cell-cycle arrest effects.
Artesunate induces G0/G1 arrest and apoptosis via increased intracellular ROS, supporting oxidative stress and apoptosis signatures.
Artesunate inhibits NF-kB signaling and MUC5AC expression in pulmonary epithelial cells, suggesting anti-inflammatory effects.
Artesunate reduces Akt/FoxO3-mediated apoptosis and inflammation, supporting anti-apoptotic and anti-inflammatory context-dependent effects.
